description: Publicly shared daily postcards. Only add photos and notes explicitly approved for public sharing. Photos should use committed repository-relative URLs, e.g. photos/2026-11-03-amsterdam.jpg. Do not publish private cabin or exact real-time location.

entries.note: Our Grand European Adventure begins! Four travelers, one unforgettable journey. Next stop: London, then Amsterdam, where our Viking adventure awaits!
entries.photo_alt: Four travelers smiling together at Seattle airport before their flight to Europe.

entries.note: A fun stop at the famous Heineken Experience! Enjoying the sights, history, and a little Dutch brewing tradition before our Viking river cruise begins.
entries.photo_alt: Our group visiting the Heineken Experience in Amsterdam.

entries.note: We enjoyed a lovely morning exploring Amsterdam one last time, wandering the streets and soaking up the sights before boarding our transfer to the ship. After several wonderful days discovering the city, it was exciting to finally arrive at our Viking longship and begin the next chapter of our European adventure. Of course, we had to capture a picture together outside our home on the river for the next several days. Let the cruising begin!
entries.photo_alt: Our group outside our Viking river cruise ship on embarkation day.
